title: Homomorphism and VC-dimension thresholds: spectra and separations
summary: Minimum-degree thresholds ask when excluding a fixed graph $H$ forces a dense graph to admit a simple global description. For each fixed chromatic number, the chromatic threshold has only three possible values. We show that this finite-spectrum phenomenon is special to chromatic threshold: already among $3$-chromatic graphs, both the homomorphism and VC-dimension thresholds have infinite spectra and are nonmonotone under taking induced subgraphs.
